rachel_cs: Quick: drafting a one-pager for customers to stabilize onboarding bursts. Seeking micro-review.

ben_platform: Keep it very short for customers: 3 bullets — debounce, batch window, cache-key hygiene.

rachel_cs: Proposed customer guidance: debounce typing 150-300ms, add 10% jitter, micro-batch 50-150ms or up to 8 items.

olga_sre: Add monitoring flags for CSMs: watch 95p token latency and 429 rate by tenant. Escalate if 95p rises >20% for 6h or 429s >3% for 1h.

ben_platform: Cache key recommendation: org|tenant|route|prompt_sha; TTLs: conv prefix 20-30s, rerank 5-10m, embeddings 12-24h. Call out avoid embedding ephemeral session ids.

rachel_cs: Add short troubleshooting checklist for customer call: confirm debounce, batching, canonical cache key, pinned model if quality-sensitive, check Console traces for spikes.

olga_sre: Pasteable JS backoff snippet for customers (4 retries, exp backoff + jitter) and a one-line curl showing header X-RW-Pressure: 0.8 to indicate server pressure.

build-bot: Draft saved to /runbooks/customer-facing/onboard_stabilize_one_pager.md by @rachel_cs at 2026-09-03T11:00Z

rachel_cs: Thanks — finalizing and will schedule a 10-min drop-in with CSM rotation.
